All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AdvancedModelBoxResolver
Resolver for the AdvancedEntityModel / AdvancedModelBox toolkit, shipped by two libraries under different package names: Citadel (Alex's Mobs, Ice and Fire) and Uranus (Ice and Fire Community Edition).
AgeableListResolver
Resolver for the AgeableListModel family — the base of most vanilla mob models (humanoids, quadrupeds, and many others).
AppearanceOverride
A sparse override of an eye's EyeAppearance: each field is optional and, when absent, falls back to the underlying value (a mob's datapack appearance, via EyeAppearance.overlay(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state.AppearanceOverride)).
Attachment
A resolved attach point: the ordered transforms that carry a pose from the model's base render space into a named part's animated space.
BehaviorInstance
The mutable runtime state of the one behavior a mob is currently playing.
BehaviorSettings
The server's behavior settings as clients receive them, for what clients run themselves: the OngoingBehaviors on every eyed mob, and the expressions of placed mob heads and the hand-held Googly Eyes.
BehaviorSettings.AmbientSlot
A deterministic ambient slot shared by the presentation and held-reaction eligibility.
BoatEyeLayout
Vanilla boat eligibility and hull/raft attachment selection, shared by both sides.
ChildMapResolver
Catch-all resolver for any vanilla EntityModel that isn't a HierarchicalModel or AgeableListModel — and the final fallback for everything else.
ClientConfig
Client-local rendering preferences shared across loaders.
ClientEyeConfigs
Client-side store of the resolved server eye state: the per-entity eye geometry configs, from EyeConfigSyncPacket, and the current googlyEyesEnabled master switch and the behavior settings clients run behaviors from, from EyeSettingsPacket.
ClientEyeRuntime
Loader-neutral owner of mob, boat, placed-head, framed-item, and held eye simulations and their lifecycle, and of the scope that tells an item draw which animation it belongs to.
ClientEyeRuntime.DrawContext
 
ClientEyeRuntime.GuiKey
 
ClientEyeRuntime.GuiKind
 
ClientIntegrationFailures
Logs recoverable client integration failures once each.
ClientLifecycle
Per-tick and disconnect housekeeping for client-side eye state, shared by every loader's client hooks.
ClientNetworkHandler
Applies the server-to-client payloads on the client game thread.
ClientNetworking
Physical-client loader bridge for native serverbound payload sends.
ClientRenderLayers
Installs the vanilla-model eye layer on living renderers after renderer rebuilds.
ConfigValue<T>
One configuration setting: everything each loader needs to declare it in its config file, plus the mutable, validated runtime view of the value that file holds.
ConfigValue.Flag
A boolean setting.
ConfigValue.Parsed<D>
A string-list setting with a derived view; see ConfigValue.parsedStrings(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.List<java.lang.String>, java.util.function.Predicate<java.lang.String>, java.util.function.Function<java.util.List<java.lang.String>, D>, java.lang.String).
ConfigValue.Ranged
An integer setting clamped to [min, max].
EntityPersistentData
Returns the mod-owned persistent compound attached to an entity.
EyeAngerPacket
Server → client: entity entityId became angry or calmed down.
EyeAppearance
The concrete, placement-independent look of an eye: cornea color, iris color, and whether it glows.
EyeAttachmentResolver
Strategy for getting from an entity model's base render pose into the animated space of a named attachment part, so eyes can be drawn relative to it.
EyeBehavior
The named one-shot eye expressions a mob can play, keyed by a ResourceLocation id; the behaviors that last as long as a mob stays in some state are the OngoingBehaviors.
EyeBehaviorTriggerPacket
Server-to-client transient expression on an entity's applied eyes or one specified held hand.
EyeBehaviorTriggerPacket.Target
 
EyeColor
One RGB color, each channel 0..1.
EyeConfigLimits
Shared semantic and work-budget validation for authored and synchronized eye geometry.
EyeConfigLimits.Issue
A validation reason with localizable feedback and a language-independent log diagnostic.
EyeConfigModel
The complete eye-definition data model shared by datapack loading, runtime selection, network synchronization, and picker export.
EyeConfigModel.ConfigFile
Raw datapack file structure (one file per entity).
EyeConfigModel.HeadConfig
One head attachment and the eyes placed on it.
EyeConfigModel.RuntimeConfig
Runtime structure selected by version and age, then synchronized to clients.
EyeConfigModel.RuntimeConfigSet
The adult, baby, and age-independent runtime configs for one entity type.
EyeConfigModel.Variant
One weighted placement arrangement.
EyeConfigModel.VersionedEntry
One version- and age-selectable entry in a datapack file.
EyeConfigReloadListener
Loads eye geometry configs from datapacks: scans data/<namespace>/eyes/*.json, one file per entity (the file path is the entity id).
EyeConfigSyncPacket
Server-to-client synchronization of the complete resolved eye-definition set, with the set's NBT encoding.
EyeDefinition
The complete datapack description of one eye on a mob: its EyePlacement (where/how big/aimed) plus its EyeAppearance (color/glow).
EyeDraft
Mutable working copy of one eye while authoring in the picker.
EyeInfluence
What a single active EyeBehavior exerts on one eye for one simulation tick (not one frame).
EyeInspector
Client action-bar verdict for whether the aimed entity or placed mob head can currently receive googly eyes.
EyeItemProperties
The appearance carried by an eye-bearing item, stored as the "EyeProperties" stack NBT compound.
EyeItemService
Loader-neutral implementation of applying and harvesting googly-eye items.
EyeItemService.Verdict
Whether a target can receive eyes, and why not; each side answers from the state it holds.
EyeModifierRecipe
Special crafting recipe that edits a harvested/looted googly eye's appearance: exactly one googly_eye plus exactly one modifier ingredient (see EyeModifierRecipe.modify(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state.AppearanceOverride, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack)).
EyePlacement
The placement (geometry) of a single eye on a mob: offset from the attach joint, sizes, and aim.
EyeRenderData
Per-frame eye decision for one living entity, taken by the eye layer that renders it.
EyeSettingsPacket
Server → client: the googlyEyesEnabled master switch and the behavior settings clients run behaviors from.
EyeState
Persistent, mutable entity eye state — the override layer that sits on top of the shared datapack config (EyeConfigModel).
EyeState.Snapshot
The full portable eye state of one supported entity or placed mob head, and its one NBT form: the three keys above in a mod-owned compound.
EyeStatePacket
Server → client sync of a single entity's full eye state: the hasGooglyEyes flag, the chosen placement-variant roll, plus the optional per-mob appearance overrides (see EyeState).
GeckoCompat
Soft-dependency gate for the optional GeckoLib renderer integration.
GeckoIntegration
GeckoLib-referencing entry points, reached only via GeckoCompat or from loader listeners registered after its presence check (so this class — and the GeckoLib classes it touches — load only when GeckoLib is present).
GeoBones
GeckoLib bone access — the GeckoLib analog of vanilla part resolution.
Gizmo
Draws the Blockbench/Blender-style transform gizmo for the selected part: RGB = XYZ axes (3 blocks each way), a cube only on each positive end, and an origin marker.
GooglyClientCommands
The /sg command tree — the in-game eye-placement CLI.
GooglyEyeItem
A single eye, as an item.
GooglyEyeItemFactory
Constructs the registered GooglyEyeItem instance.
GooglyEyeItemRenderer
Renders a googly_eye item as the actual 3D ModelGooglyEye, tinted by the item's AppearanceOverride.
GooglyEyeRenderer
The mod's one eye-drawing path: mob eyes for both render layers (the vanilla LayerGooglyEyes and the GeckoLib GooglyGeoLayer), picker previews, and the 3D eye item all draw through GooglyEyeRenderer.drawEye(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource, int, int, float[], float[], float, float, float, boolean).
GooglyGeoLayer<T extends net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity & software.bernie.geckolib.core.animatable.GeoAnimatable>
GeckoLib render layer that draws googly eyes on named bones (the GeckoLib counterpart of LayerGooglyEyes).
GooglyServerCommands
Server-owned /sg commands.
GooglyTracker
Per-entity client-side eye state: the GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil-physics simulator for every configured eye, plus which BehaviorInstance (if any) is currently playing on that entity.
GooglyTracker.EyeInfo
Physics state for one pupil: its position and velocity in the eye's unit disk, the head orientation used to derive angular forcing, and the non-physical overlay values (grow/blink/tint) an active behavior writes each tick.
HeadInfo
Resolved view of one entity eye configuration after age and weighted placement-variant selection.
HierarchicalResolver
Resolver for the HierarchicalModel family (a named root + child maps).
ItemDestruction
Reports an item a player broke, for uses that end the click outside the vanilla code that reports it.
LayerGooglyEyes<T extends net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity,M extends net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<T>>
Eye layer for vanilla-style LivingEntityRenderers.
LLibraryResolver
Resolver for LLibrary-style models.
LookTarget
Ray-picks the living entity a player is aiming at, out to reach blocks, for the /sg admin and picker spawn verbs, which target the looked-at mob past vanilla's interaction reach.
MaybeFloatArgumentType
A Brigadier argument that parses either a number or the literal ~ — the "leave this axis/angle unchanged" no-op.
MobSpawning
Runs a mob's spawn finalization the way the loader's own spawn paths do, so other mods' finalize-spawn listeners see mobs the mod spawns.
ModContent
Everything the mod registers, declared once and registered through Registration: the Googly Eye (an ingredient) and the Slimy Eye it crafts into (the applicator), which carry the same appearance NBT; the shears-only Optometrist enchantment; the mod's creative tab; and the serializers for the eye-modifier and Slimy Eye recipes.
ModelGooglyEye
Closed, faceted eye geometry used by mob eyes, picker previews, and eye items.
ModelMemo<K,V>
Memoizes a value per (model instance, attach token), misses included.
ModelMemo.Resolver<K,V>
Computes the value for a (model, token) pair.
ModelPartVocabulary
The picker's single view of a living model's attachment vocabulary.
ModVersionLookup
Resolves the loaded version string for a config namespace.
Networking
Loader bridge for native clientbound payload sends.
NetworkProtocol
The mod's network version.
OngoingBehavior
The named eye behaviors that last as long as the mob stays in some state, as opposed to the one-shot EyeBehavior expressions.
OptometristEnchantment
"Optometrist" — a shears-only enchantment that enables non-lethal eye harvesting: right-clicking an eyed mob with optometrist shears pulls its googly eyes off without harming it (see EyeItemService).
Payload
One of the mod's payloads: its id and its body.
Payload.Clientbound<T extends Payload>
A payload the server sends.
Payload.Serverbound<T extends Payload>
A payload a client sends.
PickerExporter
Turns picker drafts into datapack JSON.
PickerExportPacket
Client → server: "write this authored eye config for entityTypeId into the world datapack and reload" — the wire half of /sg export.
PickerExportService
Server-side half of /sg export (reached via PickerExportPacket): validates a client-authored eye config, writes it as canonical datapack JSON into the world's somegoogly-picker pack, and reloads datapacks as /reload does so it persists and re-syncs through the normal path.
PickerFreezePacket
Client → server: "freeze the mob I'm editing" (or release it).
PickerFreezeService
Server-owned picker mob freezing: a picker-targeted mob is held NoAi=true while edited and restored to its pre-picker value when released.
PickerGate
Server-side authorization and throttling for client-driven picker operations — the two halves of the same gate, always checked together by the packet handlers.
PickerHud
Text HUD for the part picker: a live, read-only view of the locked mob, the selected part, and the saved eye list (two lines per eye), with the eye currently being edited via /sg highlighted.
PickerInput
The picker's keybindings, all rebindable in Options → Controls, and the routing of their presses to PickerState while the picker is active.
PickerSpawnService
Authoring aid behind /sg spawnall: spawns one of every mob that could wear googly eyes — every summonable living entity, whether or not it has an eye config yet — so the picker can be used on any of them without hunting each one down in survival.
PickerSpawnService.SpawnRefusal
Why /sg spawn and /sg spawnall refuse an entity type, in the order PickerSpawnService.refusal(net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType<?>) checks them, with the feedback each command gives.
PickerState
In-world eye-placement authoring state, driven by the /sg CLI and the keyboard picker, which share this state.
PickerState.Draft
One retained draft with its complete species and life-stage identity.
PickerState.DraftKey
The species and life stage whose placements a draft describes.
PickerState.DraftSession
Retained picker drafts and selection, independent of crosshair and renderer lookup.
PickerState.DraftVariant
One weighted placement arrangement being authored: its relative weight plus its own eye list.
PickerState.ListedEye
One saved eye plus the part token it attaches to.
PresentationEyes
One presentation's loose eye or configured eye layout and ambient expressions.
PresentationEyes.Draw
The animation an item draw uses and that draw's partial tick; PresentationEyes.Draw.NONE outside animated draws.
RabbitLlamaResolver
Resolver for RabbitModel and LlamaModel — two vanilla models that extend EntityModel directly (neither HierarchicalModel nor AgeableListModel) and hand-roll their own scale/translate wraps around groups of their top-level parts inside renderToBuffer, applied and popped entirely outside the part tree, where a render layer's PoseStack never sees them.
Registration
Registers the mod's content under its namespace the loader's way: Forge through deferred registers, Fabric directly into the vanilla registries.
Resolvers
Picks the first EyeAttachmentResolver that handles a given model.
ServerBehaviorScheduler
The single authority for which eye behavior a mob is playing, and when.
ServerConfig
Server-authoritative spawn settings.
ServerEyeConfigs
Server-authoritative store of eye geometry configs, loaded from datapacks by EyeConfigReloadListener.
ServerServices
Loader-neutral server lifecycle hooks that coordinate several services.
SkullEyeRenderer
Draws the eyes of placed mob heads and head items.
SkullEyeState
Eye state of a placed mob head and of a head item.
SkullEyeState.HeadShape
How a head of one mob relates to that mob's eye layout.
SkullEyeState.Holder
The head block entity's side of the eye-state compound, added by a Mixin.
SlimyEyeItem
A googly eye bedded in a slimeball: the applicator.
SlimyEyeRecipe
Googly eye + slimeball → slimy eye, carrying all of the eye's NBT (its appearance, name, and the rest) onto the result, as a vanilla transmute does, so the applied mob ends up with the eye you actually dyed or harvested.
SlimyEyeRecipe.Serializer
Parses the ordinary shapeless recipe shape.
SomeGooglyCommon
Mod identity shared by every platform.
ThirdPartyModelWraps
Owns whole-model and named-root-group transforms that models apply outside their part tree — a model-wide pushPose → scale → translate wrapped entirely inside the model's own renderToBuffer.
VersionRangeMatcher
Minimal matcher for exact versions and bracket ranges such as [1.2.0,1.3.0), plus the nearest-generation fallback pick (nearestVersion(java.util.Collection<java.lang.String>, java.lang.String)) used when no entry matches at all and the range synthesis (rangeFor(java.lang.String)) used when exporting definitions for optional mods.
